weather_report:
As night envelops Boston, the city sinks into a tranquil hush, the clear skies above revealing a plethora of stars twinkling like diamonds adorned against deep velvet. The temperature dips to a crisp 30 degrees, a reminder of the season’s transition into the chill of late autumn. A gentle westerly breeze whispers through the streets, rustling the leaves that remain, adding to the soft symphony of the evening.

As dawn breaks tomorrow, a sunny disposition awaits the city, with a promise of warmth reaching near 55 degrees. The day will unfold serenely, the sunlight spilling across the Boston skyline, illuminating the historic facades and casting playful shadows across the Common. It is a day ripe for leisurely strolls, perhaps along the Charles River, where the waters will glisten under the sun’s embrace, inviting moments of reflection and serenity. Dress comfortably, layering to accommodate the lingering chill of the morning; a light jacket will serve well as you embark on your gentle adventures. Consider visiting local cafes, sipping on warm brews while watching the world awaken, or meandering through the city’s parks where the late-autumn foliage still clings to its vivid hues. Such simple pleasures unfurl beautifully beneath tomorrow’s sunny skies.
